summary: Completed Epic E4 (Customer Account) testing. Backend: 114/118 tests passed (96.6%) - all E4 endpoints working correctly. Frontend: Core account features working - registration, login, profile edit, address CRUD, wishlist display, order history with cancellation. Critical issue: guest→user wishlist merge not working. Backend single-default invariant verified correct via DB inspection.

Backend: POST /api/addresses - creates address, second with is_default=true moves default
Backend: GET /api/addresses - returns only caller's addresses, single default invariant maintained (verified in DB)
Backend: POST /api/addresses/{id}/default - sets address as sole default
Backend: PUT /api/addresses/{id} - edits address (owner-only)
Backend: DELETE /api/addresses/{id} - removes address, promotes another to default if needed
Backend: Address IDOR - user B cannot PUT or DELETE user A's address (returns 404)
Backend: GET /api/wishlist - returns {product_ids:[...]} with auth, 401 without auth
Backend: POST /api/wishlist/toggle - adds/removes product, returns 400 for nonexistent product_id
Backend: POST /api/wishlist/merge - returns deduped union, drops invalid product_ids
Backend: No 5xx errors on malformed requests (empty body, missing fields)
